reasoning: 1. TARGET ENGAGEMENT: No direct target engagement data reported. No PK/PD data showing HMG-CoA reductase inhibition, COX inhibition, or microbiome changes. 2. PATHWAY MODULATION: Biomarker data shows mixed signals - Ki67 proliferation increased in all arms including placebo (+6.5% atorvastatin, +12.2% sulindac, +34.7% inulin, +13.6% placebo), suggesting no meaningful anti-proliferative effect. Caspase-3 apoptosis marker increased substantially in all arms (~106-132%) with no clear treatment-specific pattern. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint (ACF reduction) failed across all three arms. Atorvastatin showed +8.4% increase vs placebo -8.6% (p=0.3), sulindac showed -13.3% vs placebo -8.6% (p=0.6), inulin showed -8.8% vs placebo -8.6% (p=0.92). None achieved statistical significance. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Study appears adequately powered with 85 patients over 26 weeks. No obvious trial design issues.
